title: Right-derived transport commutes with cyclic conjugation
statement: Let C and D be Grothendieck abelian categories [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], F and G additive autoequivalences with their fixed-pair categories [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category], and use chosen ordinary derived categories in independent morphism universes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let L:C→D be additive left exact, and e:L⋙G≅F⋙L. Let hF and hC be arbitrary witnesses that every complex in C^F, respectively C, admits a quasi-isomorphism into a K-injective complex. Write J=R(mapOfNatIso e) and H=RL for the recorded universal right-derived functors [def-sfb-right-derived-functor], and alpha=cyclicDerivedRightForgetComparison for the unique unit-normalized comparison of [def-sf-cyclic-derived-hom-data]. Equip H with any coherent integer-shift structure for which its recorded computation unit commutes with shifts. Write tr for cyclicDerivedHomTransport with this structure and alpha. For every M,N in D(C^F), integer r and u in V^r(M,N), one has tr(T^r(u))=T^r(tr(u)), with T the conjugation action of [def-sf-cyclic-derived-hom-data]. No boundedness is required.

Exact forgetting preserves K-injectives by [lem-sf-fixed-pair-derived-forget-comparison], and exact autoequivalences do likewise. Compute the recorded derived functors on these models using their invertible computation units [def-sfb-right-derived-functor].

proof.text: The unit equation for alpha identifies the underlying computation with L(UI). At each model the equality defining mapOfNatIso e identifies the target structure isomorphism with L(theta) composed with e. Applying the inverse gives the analogous formula for the inverse structure. These formulas are natural in homotopy morphisms.

proof.text: Represent the underlying degree-r morphism by a homotopy class into the shifted K-injective target using [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived]. Unit shift compatibility identifies its shifted computation with that of the target. Expand the two occurrences of T using [def-sf-cyclic-derived-hom-data]. Substitute the structure equations at M and N; naturality of e, associativity and the inverse identities cancel all comparison factors. This proves tr(Tu)=T(tr(u)). Naturality of the units and alpha transports the equality along the model isomorphisms. No boundary assertion or cohomological bound is used.

theorem cyclicDerivedHomTransport_rightDerived_action
    (M N : DerivedCategory (IsoAlgebra F)) (r : ℤ)
    (u : CyclicDerivedHom F M N r) :
    cyclicDerivedHomTransport F G
      ((mapOfNatIso e).rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutions hF)
      (L.rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutions hC)
      (fun r ↦ (L.rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutions hC).commShiftIso r)
      (cyclicDerivedRightForgetComparison F G L e hF hC) M N r
      (cyclicDerivedHomAction F M N r u) =
      cyclicDerivedHomAction G
        (((mapOfNatIso e).rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutions hF).obj M)
        (((mapOfNatIso e).rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutions hF).obj N) r
        (cyclicDerivedHomTransport F G
          ((mapOfNatIso e).rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutions hF)
          (L.rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutions hC)
          (fun r ↦ (L.rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutions hC).commShiftIso r)
          (cyclicDerivedRightForgetComparison F G L e hF hC) M N r u)
